ctgov.result: 2 P1/P2 trials returned: NCT07165340 (investigator-initiated, lead = UT Health Science Center Houston, Tactile is collaborator only) and NCT02946021 (Tactile-sponsored, COMPLETED 2018). no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Commercial-stage at-home medical device company (pneumatic compression for lymphedema/CVI; HFCWO vest for airway clearance). All products are FDA 510(k)-cleared and on market. No proprietary drug pipeline. The two ClinicalTrials.gov P1/P2 hits are either an investigator-initiated study led by UT Health Houston (Tactile only collaborator) or a completed 2018 device study; neither qualifies as an active P1/P2/P3 development asset.
